cases.sentence: Рано утром, в ___ недели , когда было еще темно, Мария Магдалина пошла к гробнице и увидела, что камень, закрывавший вход в гробницу, убран.
cases.explain: «первый день» — after the preposition «в», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: Now on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene went early, while it was still dark, to the tomb, and saw the stone taken away from the tomb.

cases.sentence: Петр и ___ сразу же побежали к гробнице.
cases.explain: «другой ученик» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Therefore Peter and the other disciple went out, and they went toward the tomb.

cases.sentence: Они оба бежали, но ___ обогнал Петра и прибежал к гробнице первым.
cases.explain: «второй ученик» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: They both ran together. The other disciple outran Peter, and came to the tomb first.

cases.explain: «льняных полотен» — after the preposition «от», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Then Simon Peter came, following him, and entered into the tomb. He saw the linen cloths lying,

cases.sentence: Тогда и ___, прибежавший к гробнице первым, тоже вошел внутрь.
cases.explain: «другой ученик» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: So then the other disciple who came first to the tomb also entered in, and he saw and believed.

cases.sentence: Вечером в ___ недели, когда ученики собрались вместе и двери дома, где они находились, были заперты из боязни перед иудеями, пришел Иисус.
cases.explain: «первый день» — after the preposition «в», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: When therefore it was evening on that day, the first day of the week, and when the doors were locked where the disciples were assembled, for fear of the Jews, Jesus came and stood in the middle, and said to them, “Peace be to you.”

cases.sentence: Фомы, которого еще называли Близнец, одного из двенадцати, не было с ___, когда приходил Иисус.
cases.explain: «другими учениками» — after the preposition «с», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: But Thomas, one of the twelve, called Didymus, wasn’t with them when Jesus came.

cases.explain: «другие ученики» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: The other disciples therefore said to him, “We have seen the Lord!” But he said to them, “Unless I see in his hands the print of the nails, put my finger into the print of the nails, and put my hand into his side, I will not believe.”

cases.sentence: Иисус совершил в присутствии Своих учеников и много ___, о которых в этой книге не написано.
cases.explain: «других знамений» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Therefore Jesus did many other signs in the presence of his disciples, which are not written in this book;
